description: A free, MIT-licensed C++ library for creating, reading and editing PowerPoint .pptx presentations. It builds the Office Open XML package itself, so it needs no PowerPoint installation, no COM interop and no proprietary runtime. This package carries static libraries for MSVC on Windows: x64 and Win32, Debug and Release. It does not render or convert: there is no PDF, image or HTML export.
title: Aspose.Slides FOSS for C++
